Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the Engineer (Alex) implemented the topological sort algorithm incorrectly. Specifically, the queue was initialized with courses that have an in-degree greater than 0 (`if indegree[i] > 0`), whereas it should be courses with an in-degree of 0 (`if indegree[i] == 0`). This fundamental error causes the algorithm to start processing courses that have unmet prerequisites, leading to an incorrect or empty result instead of a valid topological order.
